reviews.comment:
La estación muy poco mantenida. Los baños impresentables. Justo llegue 13.50 de un domingo y los empleados se querían ir antes del cambio de turno que era a las 14 y los que entraban no querían empezar antes. 15 minutos esperando con una cola terrible para cargar nafta y una mujer con un problema de salud que necesitaba combustible para llegar a la Clínica en Mar del Plata. Un desastre.

(Translated by Google)
The station was very poorly maintained. The bathrooms were appalling. I arrived at 1:50 PM on a Sunday, and the employees wanted to leave before the shift change at 2:00 PM, and the incoming staff didn't want to start early. I waited 15 minutes in a terrible line to fill up with gas, and there was a woman with a health problem who needed fuel to get to the clinic in Mar del Plata. A disaster.
